༄༅/ /zhing sgrub zin bris kyi lhan thabs nyung bsdus bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// zhing sgrub zin bris kyi lhan thabs nyung bsdus bzhugs so//

na mo a mi tā bha ya: zhing sgrub bsnyen pa sogs kyi sta gon rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum sogs ni zin bris ltar la/ rang gzhan gshin don sta gon rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum la/ rgyas pa ni zhing bkod zhal thang bshams pa'i mdun/ mchod stegs steng du 'bru'i tshom bu 'dab brgyad kyi dbus su sku gzugs bzhag /g.yas su rnam rgyal bum pa rdzas ldan rgyan 'dzom/ g.yon du las bum mdun du zlum gtor rgyan ldan/ de'i mdun sman raka gtor gsum dang zhing skyong gtor ma/ bkra shis rdzas rtags rgyal srid sna bdun 'bur ma'am ni tsaka li/ nyer spyod gong nas 'phred bkram mam btsugs pa gang bde mdzes par brgyan/ de mthar mchod pa sna bdun bsham: ༈ 'bring po zlum gtor rtse la 'od dpag tsaka li btsugs/ bum pa gnyis dang sman raka gtor gsum mchod pa sna bdun bsham pas mthus/ ༈ bsdus pa mdun bskyed rten rin po che'i snod 'brus bkang ste rdo rje bzhag /bum pa gtor ma gang 'dzom bsham/ thog mar sngon 'gro ni cog rdog bsham la/ rin chen snod du sogs nas khā hi gsum dang gats+tsha gats+tsha ces phyi rol dor/ na mo dkon mchog gsum sogs 'od dpag las byang tshang bar bsnyen pa'i mtshams par 'don nas/ rang nyid sems dpa' 'jig rten dbang phyug dkar// zhal gcig phyag bzhi dang po thal sbyar dang*// 'og mas shel phreng dang ni pad dkar 'dzin// thor tshugs dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan// sku smad pad+ma'i nang nub skyil krung bzhugs// thugs kar mdun du bskyed pa lta bu yi// 'od dpag med pa gtso 'khor gsum po dang*// bde chen zhing bkod yongs su rdzogs par gsal// gtso bo'i thugs kar zla steng hrīḥyig mthar// a mi dhe wa'i sngags 'phreng g.yas su 'khor// de las 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pa// mdzod spu nas thon nam mkha' khyab par 'phros// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad mchod// rgyal ba'i byin rlabs bsdus nas rang la thim// 'gro ba sems can kun gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs// bde ba can du skye ba'i skal ldan gyur// yul phyogs phyi snod bde chen zhing du gyur// nang bcud sems can 'od dpag med pa'i sku// yab yum sras dang sems dpa' sems ma dang*// sangs rgyas byang sems 'phags pa'i dge 'dun gyur// sngags sgra sgrogs pas 'khor ba dong nas sprugs// gzugs can gzugs med sems can thams cad kun// 'od dpag med pa'i go 'phang thob par gyur// oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ

brgya'am ci mang bzlas so// rang gi thugs ka'i sngags phreng 'od zer las// hrīḥyig dmar po byi ru'i phreng ba ltar// zhal nas thon cing mdun bskyed zhal du bzhugs// thugs ka'i sngags phreng la thim thugs rgyud bskul// de las hrīḥyig dmar po'i phreng ba byon// lte ba nas thon rang gi lte bar thim// thugs kar thim par byin rlabs dngos grub thob// mgal me'i 'khor lo bzhin du 'khor ba las/ bar du 'khor tshe 'od zer sna tshogs pa// nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing du 'phros// sangs rgyas 'od dpag med pa'i sku la thim// sku gsung thugs rgyud mnyes pa'i mchod par gyur// sku las 'od dpag med pa'i sku che phra// gsung las sngags phreng hrīḥyig dmar po dang*// thugs las rdo rje dmar po rtse lnga pa// kha ba bu yug 'tshubs pa bzhin du byon// bdag mdun rnams la sib sib thim par gyur// hrīḥ brgya rtsa'am ci mang bzlas so// de nas bdag mdun bum pa la/ mdun bskyed bum bskyed thugs ka ru// zla steng hrīḥdamar gzungs kyis bskor// rang gi thugs ka'i sngags phreng 'phros// mdun bskyed zhal bzhugs thugs rgyud bskul// gzungs sngags g.yas su 'khor ba las// 'od zer sna tshogs phyogs bcur 'phros: tshe 'das tho drangs 'gro kun gyi: sdig sgrib nyes ltung bag chags kun: ba mor nyi zer phog ltar dag: bum lha'i sku las bdud rtsi babs: bum pa bdud rtsis gang bar gyur/ gzungs ring ci mang bzlas/ las bum la/ las bum nang du rta mgrin dmar// thod dbyug zhags 'dzin dor thabs bzhugs// sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas// bum pa bdud rtsis gang bar gyur/ oṃ hā ya grī wa hūṃ phaṭa/ nyer gcig bdun sogs bzlas so// de nas bde smon rgyas pa'am/ shes bya ma'am/ phyogs dus rgyal ba'am/ bzang spyod dam thams cad tshang na dang*/ ma tshang na 'don res bya/ de lta bu'i cho ga bsdus pa tshar gcig la rung tsam lam/

gzhung rkyang ni rang don thugs dam yin/ gzhan don bdag mdun bum gsum tshang ma dang*/ bde smon rnams ma tshang na mi rung*/ gzhung tshe 'gugs dang sngags sogs do nub tshar gcig /gshin don la mi dgos/ de yang gson po'i rim gro la tshe chog byed na tshe gzungs dang dbang rdzas dbang ltar las bde smon ma thon na mi dgos so// zhes gnas mdo bde chen gyi mdzad pa'o// gnam chos bde chen zhing sgrub kyi cho ga'i lhan thabs phan yon bsngags pa mtha' yas pa'i gzungs yod/ gnam chos bde chen zhing sgrub kyi/ byang chog bsdus pa gzhung ltar te/ cung zhig rgyas par bya 'dod na/ mdun bskyed bum bskyed thugs ka ru: zla steng hrīḥyig dmar po'i mthar: gzungs sngags g.yas su 'khor ba las: 'od zer sna tshogs phyogs bcur 'phros: tshe 'das tho drangs 'gro kun gyi: sdig sgrib nyes ltung bag chags kun: ba mo nyi zer phog ltar dag: bum lha'i sku las bdud rtsi babs: bum pa bdud rtsis gang dmigs shing : mthun mtshams bzungs 'di bdun nyer gcig: brgya rtsa la sogs ci 'grub bzlas: bye ma la yang sngags na legs: na mo rat+na tra yā ya: na mo bha ga wa te: a mi ta bhā ya: ta thā ga tā ya: ar+ha te saṃ myak+saṃ bud+dhā ya: tad+ya thā: oṃ a mi te: a mi tod+bha we: a mi ta saṃ bha we: a mi ta bikrān+te: a mi ta gā mi nī: ga ga na kīrti ka re sarba kle sha k+ṣa yaṃ ka ri swā hā: gzungs 'di lan gcig brjod pas kyang*/ bskal pa 'bum du bsags pa yi// las kyi sgrib pa byang bar 'gyur// gzhan yang phan yon dpag med pa// bcom ldan thub pa'i zhal nas gsungs// 'od dpag med pa'i gzungs 'di ni// rgyud 'bum nang na bzhugs pa yin// bya ba'i rgyud du gtogs lags kyang*// bya rgyud bla med nyams len lugs// 'di la sbyar bas 'gal ba med// tshe gzungs bya rgyud yin mod kyang*// bla med lugs la sbyar dang mtshungs// zhes pa bde chen zhing sgrub kyi// lhan thabs rā ga a s+yas sbyar// las bum ni/

las bum nang du rta mgrin dmar: thod dbyug zhags 'dzin dor stabs bzhugs: sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas: bum pa bdud rtsis gang bar gyur: oṃ ha ya grī wa hūṃ phaṭa: bdun nam nyer gcig bzlas so// ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ hrīḥlas byung ba'i rta mchog sku: nyi ma'i mdog mtshungs dgra bgegs bsregs: bdud bzhi'i dpung rnams 'joms mdzad pa: dpa' bo rta mgrin phyag 'tshal bstod: las bum gyi khro bos gegs rnams bzlog pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cig / ces gnas mdo sangs rgyas kyis lhan thabs su sbyar ba'o/// /
